title: Launch Harmony: Runbook for Milestones, Scope Locks, and Cut Criteria
creator: Ava Martinez
description: This ticket defines a concise, executable runbook to synchronize milestone signals, scope-lock behavior, and cut criteria across the API, Console, and Runtime teams. Objective: reduce last-minute ambiguities during the release train by standardizing who declares scope freeze, which signals permit scope reductions, and how rollback/quick-fix windows are executed. The runbook will cover milestone definitions (alpha/beta/canary/stable), owner mappings for each milestone, required signoffs, risk tiers, and a template for release notes coordination. It will also capture cut criteria logic (quantitative SLOs, critical bug thresholds, compatibility validation pass-rate) and automated gating signals (smoke test dashboards, end-to-end trace failure rates, canary latency p95). This artifact is intended to be the single source of truth for launch decisions for the API/Console/Runtime train and used by PM, Eng, Design, and Solutions teams during the ship window.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook document accepted by PM leads (API/Console/Runtime) and uploaded to Confluence with versioned header
Milestone owner matrix published with explicit approvers for scope-lock and rollback decisions
Cut criteria defined with measurable signals and thresholds (SLO, error-rate, performance) and linked to dashboards
Release notes template created with owners for each section (features, breaking changes, known issues, migration steps) and a staging checklist
A dry-run tabletop exercise scheduled with Eng, QA, SRE, Design, and Growth and outcomes recorded
Communication templates (customer comms, internal escalation, partner notice) ready and validated by Comms
